# Cleveland 1999.127, Christ Carrying the Cross leaf

A Book of Hours leaf (Hours of the Cross, Sext) painted in Brittany (?) about 1410–1420, in the Cleveland Museum of Art.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `cma-1999-127`, historical, 1 asset.
